## Try It Out!
### Grant Sharetribe user permissions after Stripe payment

Automatically grant marketplace permissions (transaction rights, posting rights) when a user completes a Stripe payment. Supports lead fee, subscription, and one-time payment models.

### How it works
* The Stripe Trigger fires when a checkout session is completed.
* The Sharetribe Update Permissions action grants the specified permissions to the user identified by the `client_reference_id` from Stripe.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Stripe credentials.
2. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
3. Set up a Stripe Checkout page for your fee (lead fee, subscription, etc.).
4. **Critical**: Pass the Sharetribe User ID as `client_reference_id` in your Stripe Checkout session.
5. Enable "Restrict transaction rights" or "Restrict posting rights" in Sharetribe Console > Build > General.
6. Configure which permissions to grant in the Update Permissions node.
7. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials and permission restrictions enabled
* Stripe account with payment product configured
* Your frontend must pass User ID as `client_reference_id` to Stripe Checkout

### How to customize
* Adjust the three permission flags to match your business model.
* Pair with "Revoke transaction rights after transaction" for a pay-per-lead model.
* Add a Gmail notification to confirm the permission grant.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Stripe payment completed
Fires when a customer completes checkout. The `client_reference_id` contains the Sharetribe User ID.

## 2. Grant permissions
Updates the user's marketplace permissions. Configure which rights to enable: create listings, initiate transactions, and/or read data.
